findings.title: get_monitor_environment_context returns the raw config instead of the converted copy
findings.body: The function creates a local `config` copy and converts `schedule_type` to its display value, but the returned dictionary uses `monitor_environment.monitor.config` instead of `config`. The converted value is therefore discarded, and the occurrence event context contains the raw internal `schedule_type` rather than the human-readable value. Line 168 should return `config`.

findings.title: Plural failure reason repeats "check-ins"
findings.body: `get_failure_reason` builds strings such as "3 missed check-ins" and then formats them with `"%(problem_checkins)s check-ins detected"`, producing "3 missed check-ins check-ins detected". The docstring examples show the intended output without the duplicated "check-ins", and this is user-facing evidence text. The final format string should not append "check-ins" after labels that already contain it.
